selected_skill.name: update-skills
selected_skill.reason: The skill's core workflow is deciding how to capture durable learnings as reusable agent skills or instructions, which maps directly to educational documentation and course-production knowledge capture.

task_design.scenario: A curriculum operations team needs a future-facing skill distilled from a realistic course-production incident involving metadata drift, transcript/caption mismatches, rubric alignment, and publishing checks.
task_design.input_surface: A session bundle of tickets, review notes, CI logs, metadata snapshots, style-guide excerpts, repository inventory snapshots, and a local HTTP knowledge service.
task_design.expected_agent_work: Read evidence, cross-check local API records, check existing instructions and skills for duplication risk, decide skill vs instruction vs existing-file update, draft a reusable skill, and emit a structured capture report.

upstream_downstream_chain: verifier schema, evidence, and generalization checks
environment.skill_isolation: The with-skill runtime contains environment/skills/update-skills copied into standard agent skill locations. The without-skill runtime removes environment/skills and the Dockerfile conditionally skips skill copying without changing data, tests, dependencies, or instructions.

main_tests: evidence sources resolve to real files or API endpoints
repository inventory is used to justify not adding a brief learning or updating an existing narrow skill
skill-vs-instruction decision matches the multi-step reusable-learning scenario
procedure and quality checks are actionable
guardrail_tests: no modification of protected input bundle
no modification of provided skill copy
no fake evidence or hidden-output dependency
no overfitting to one ticket, course id, build id, or exact file path outside evidence sections
no bypass language such as deleting checks, mocking services, or skipping validation

experiment_requirements.oracle: Must pass all verifier checks in E2B.
experiment_requirements.with_skill: Must pass in E2B using only the copied update-skills skill.
experiment_requirements.without_skill: Must retain at least one verifier failure or fail by timeout; any difference from with_skill must come only from environment/skills and skill-copy behavior.
